change: Four calls per model (twelve total), plus a separately labeled pre-holdout secondary endpoint.

secondary_endpoint_amendment.reason: Development invalid/abstained judgments prevent strict primary complete-grid inference; original primary retained unchanged.
secondary_endpoint_amendment.endpoint: Delivered agreement over scheduled attempted judgments: valid categorical vote/reference agreement; observed abstain/invalid/error zero; missing/unattempted block inference.
secondary_endpoint_amendment.allocation: Secondary exploratory contrasts alpha=.05/3, individual configurations alpha=.05/6; not joint primary-plus-secondary familywise control.

additional_descriptive_analysis: Observed human-panel vote agreement maximum; not a universal capability ceiling.
Execution repository sensitivity: equal repository means, frozen alpha/resamples/minimum families; no population-of-repositories inference.
graceful_stop: Stop new admissions and await already reserved calls.

cost_before_amendment.cost_basis: Conservative upper bound: all input at 2.5x standard uncached input price, all output at standard price. This is not an invoice.

publication_scope: Summary of the private, pre-holdout amendment; completed response content remains private.
